instruction.name: vmulwev.q.du
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned unsigned 64-bit elements in `a` and the corresponding unsigned 64-bit elements in `b`, extending both to 128-bit, and save the 128-bit result in `dst`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Dependent vector-register chain with small positive integer element values.
